notes.content:
[b][h1]1.Brand New Map-Mountville Town[/h1][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/24983458e1399dd226d96286039d4cd98f066aa7.png[/img][h3]Mountville Town has arrived!
Hurry and come to Mountville Town to participate in the temple fair![/h3]

There was a pretty good artist in Mountville Town in the past.To honor them, the villagers in Mountville Town has permanently placed replicas of their paintings throughout the adventure world.

Replicas of these paintings may randomly appear in hard Realms, elite Realms, treasure map chests, and world event chests.
Start your collection journey now!

Each painting has a fixed source. Stay active and join various events![img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/b986d9bd967bf3a063246f0ba132065574520ee1.png[/img]

Every Lunar New Year, the lively Nian Beast emerges from the deep forest to startle the villagers of Mountville Town.

Brave adventurers, venture into the New Year Secret Realm to drive away the Nian Beast and make the fair even more joyful!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/7b9c54fa1693b41fc72a1ce6a91afac6484a3b55.png[/img]
You can enter the Normal Realm once per day, with a chance to earn EXP, Dragonites, and daily gear upon completion.

Entering the Hard Realm requires 1 Entry Pass.
Clearing it grants a chance to obtain the Luan Feather Longbow & Quiver, as well as the meticulously crafted, historically inspired Tang Blade Unyielding Might!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/59e9943266a48abaaa6eaf6c0ae003a22264fe6b.png[/img]

Unlike other two-handed swords, this Tang Blade features two distinct attack modes. Which one will you choose，warrior？

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/53964c727e7681afa0973d60150b56d1ea803699.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/8e1d8cb7430e93df99415d762beee6a4603c20e1.gif[/img]
The Tang Blade can also be crafted at the Assembly Station using Meteorite Shard dropped by Nian Beast.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/2d61d25b2ba34b14ecb81e2ec23e4374f6c61947.png[/img]
The Luan Feather Longbow has a chance to come with the Firework Arrow Rain skill, while the Luan Feather Quiver may include the Firework Arrows skill.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/95e9953251d766fb0c158136726c81754a083db4.gif[/img]

During the [Blessing of the Light Dragon] event, use a [Treasure Key] to open [Light Dragon’s Gift] for a chance to obtain Nian Beast · Cloudstep and Infernal Tiger
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/77a07662531d577f30f04ed89edc0e15bb71b3a0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/6b5d56eb80e5ded7c914adb128f8c8229e41f230.png[/img]

[h1][b]16.The Building Material Vault has been upgraded—experience true Freedom in Building![/b][/h1]

A new [Building Material Storage] block has been added to the Construction Station!

This limitless storage space is dedicated to housing all your building materials—no more worrying about where to store rare furniture and construction items!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/cca8a472b194f68240638ebef61018525de43e04.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/66af660a4ea6932aed6c361411cf8d5495865891.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/835c8556f9ec841ffddb46768b9fe86850cde57d.png[/img]
Initial capacity: 60 slots, each stacking up to 999 materials. Expands automatically as more materials are added.
Shared Building Experience! 🎉 Homeowners can authorize specific friends to access the Building Material Vault, allowing collaborative home construction.
Friends with build permissions can store their materials in the owner's vault but cannot withdraw them—handle with care!
While building, authorized friends can use a quick-access window to pull materials from the vault directly into their hotkey-bar.
Materials removed from the owner's land will automatically return to the Building Material Vault!

[h1][b]17.Private Territory Permission Adjustments – A More Precise Social Experience! 🎭✨[/b][/h1]

🔹 Permissions are now divided into:

Furniture Interaction 
Food Sharing 
Building permission
Players can now have finer control over shared resources in their territory—no more dinner party mishaps!

[h1][b]18.Free Camera Mode is Here – Showcase Your Beauty from Every Angle! ✨[/b][/h1]
Now, when stationary, Players can freely move the camera to admire their heroic from a full 360-degree view!

notes.title: Dragon and Home 2.11.0.0 Version Update
notes.content:
[h1][b]Brand New World Map is here![/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/e15d9dea5acce4de8aa2090c8a3aa7a4ad05c066.jpg[/img]
Say goodbye to the old, clunky way of traveling! 
🛑 No more hunting for portals in other players' houses!

Faster, Smoother Travel: Access all key locations with three simple steps!
Easily Press M to open the world Map and click on any world to jump directly to its detailed map as shown below 👇
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/bf946a998abc33cb3eaeabff40d0b1adc5b1bf94.jpg[/img]
Last step! Click on the specific place that you want to teleport to and cost a certain amount of white dragonites to teleport. VIPs can teleport for free~
*Trace function will still be able to show and use on this new map.

Also now daily Quests will be able to be claimed on the target world map.

[h1][b]North of the World: A New Chapter in the Winter Star Festival[/b][/h1]
The gentle warmth, the soothing embrace of winter – all the beauty culminates with the arrival of the Winter Star.
The annual Winter Star Festival has begun! Adventurers, are you ready to play the melody of the Winter Star?
[h3][b]Event Duration:[/b][/h3]
From the release date of the new update until January 26, 2025.
[h3][b]About Fjord Town: [/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/2a19ba822a2f0c7c14ee77cea1af8913487208a8.png[/img]
Nestled close to the other continents, Fjord Town has become a base for adventurers. Most of the villagers have left behind their traditional fishing and hunting trades to offer various services for those who seek adventure. This year's Winter Star Festival will be held in this charming fishing village, located on the edge of the Endlands. Due to its unique location, lucky adventurers may catch a glimpse of the Aurora(Northern Lights) at night, but beware of snowstorms are frequent, so be sure to stay safe while exploring!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/1a69ce1eadf3c43e1ce514d77f348a6a304f3ac5.png[/img]
The Winter Star Festival holds great significance in this humble fishing village.
If you wish to join in the celebration and experience the warm, festive atmosphere of the Winter Star, be sure to visit this little town.

notes.title: 【Dragon and Home】2.8.0.0 Version Update
notes.content:
[h1]2.8.0.0 VERSION UPDATE CONTENT[/h1]

[h2]Void Isle[/h2]

Explore the mysterious Void Isle with new quests, enemies, and treasures.
Isolated beyond the four continents, floating in the void, these islands have lost the protection of the Tree of Life and have been corrupted by the magic born from the void, becoming a breeding ground for monsters.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/21dc676490cd676b8e4a491dd52f8abf6f462f0b.png[/img]

However, high risk, high reward. These islands, far from the mainland, have nurtured numerous treasures from the immense magical power. More and more adventurers, tempted by the treasures, are willing to risk their lives to explore the void.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/c1d560257819fa65007e0ba1db25ee38b2e69beb.png[/img]

To prevent unnecessary casualties among adventurers repairing the continent, the Lux Dracona has bestowed blessings at its ancient altar. Those who receive the blessing can temporarily shield themselves from the corrupting magic using the power of light.

The Lux Dracona Altar has thus become a base for treasure-seeking adventurers. Every day, new adventurers delve into the void with hope. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/09ba02cf542b1d873798289dea13d971b988df9e.png[/img]

Adventurers at level 10 or above can talk to Iona in the village to receive the ability quest "Void Exploration."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/b5c6c25835c7e9db0fdf93f27567c205b2fc5c3c.png[/img]

[[b]Rules: Layers and Rooms][/b]

Void lsland is divided by [Layers], each layer contains unequal number of [rooms],each
room is a challenge. When completing the challenge, corresponding challenge ranks can be obtained, which are [Bronze],[Silver], and [Gold]. 

To qualify for the next level, one must pass through all the rooms in each layer and
have a challenge rating of no less than [Silver].

[b][Rules: Near lslands and Far lslands][/b]

The Void lsland consists of the [Near Islands] and [Far lslands]
After completing the challenges of all layers in the [Near lslands] and ensuring that the
challenge rating of all layers is not lower than [Silver], the [Far lslands] will be available.

The Near Islands does not reset or change over time.
The Far Islands, influenced by the void, reset every two weeks and will have some other changes.

[b][Rules: Void Buffs][/b]
Challengers will be affected by the void, which can provide either buffs or debuffs. All challengers needs to be prepared.
Void Buffs can appear in each [Room] and entire [Far lslands].

[b][Rules: Rewards and Resets][/b]
Completing Far lslands can receive substantial rewards. Each level can receive the overall evaluation of all inter rating challenges within that level, which is the lowest rating among all inter level evaluations within that level.
Every Monday of every two weeks, the rewards for the Far lslands will be reset and
new Void buffs may be generated. The rewards for the Near lslands will not
reset over time.

[b][Rules: Entry Criteria][/b]
To qualify for the leaderboard, you must achieve a [Gold] rating in all room challenges on the 3rd level of the Far Islands. Rankings are determined by the total time taken to complete all room challenges.
All room challenges on the 3rd level of the Far Islands must be completed consecutively.[i][u] If you leave midway, your time for this attempt will not be counted in the rankings.[/u][/i]

[b][Rules: Ranking Order][/b]
Rankings are determined based on the following criteria in order:
1.Players with shorter completion times rank higher.
2.Players with lower character levels rank higher.
3.Players who qualify earlier rank higher.

[b]Rules: Rewards and Reset[/b]
Every two weeks, on Monday at 12:00 PM, a ranking settlement will be conducted based on the current leaderboard for the Far Islands. After the settlement, the leaderboard will be reset, and a new round of challenges in the Far islands will begin.
Rewards will be distributed based on the rankings after the settlement:
●1st Place: Title [i]“Lord of the Void,[/i]” valid for 14 days.
●2nd to 3rd Place: Title “[i]Void Walker,[/i]” valid for 14 days.
●4th to 10th Place: Title [i]“Void Traveler,”[/i] valid for 14 days.

[h2]Void Treasure[/h2]

You can explore the Islands by using the Lux Dracona Altar located near the village in the Breeze Plain. Rewards include White Dragonites, Shadow Dragonites, and Damaged Cores.

Damaged Cores can be exchanged for materials for Tier 2 boss gear and Essences.
*Players who rank high on the challenge leaderboard will also receive additional rewards.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/47392c0deda2a3a71f5270af7d719138fb3d2144.png[/img]



[h2]Photo System[/h2]
The photo system supports manual focus and aperture adjustment. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/2b3e6e64cbf16e1b90e0483aa4c866bbe28c5b8d.png[/img]

There are also 32 filters to choose from, making your photos vibrant and fun instantly! There's definitely one that suits you!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/5a309790039d0a13062a5083a0fecdb8d329b7d4.png[/img]


[h2]In-Game Lighting Optimization[/h2]
We've optimized the lighting and enhanced the overall visual effects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/77ad3d020026e5773666993bc7dcc9b8521558dc.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/c653e78d11a94dd6a8f88c31295ea59b7884ec10.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/5cd3fcd7cabb73f49b9a002cb1719df325c450fa.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/52b61f4b21ac82f1c414d4de99c42837280fcd78.png[/img]

[h2]New Teleport Points[/h2]

To make exploration more convenient for adventurers, new building teleport points have been added in all three worlds.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/3cfc1a66ae75bd1bddad1733dfd14e319eef7d72.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/1e32c0873f076c4f4a512309cb7866da6a4a06d5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/d2d1ba2a5092a7e40e05de5832aeb18da3196400.png[/img]


[b][h2]Here Comes The Pet System![/h2][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/bf1665d208d1cdf15f56ca0cf0eb19d376931afe.gif[/img]

In the perilous continent of adventure, do you often feel a bit lonely fighting alone?
To let our dear adventurous enjoy more fun in their journey, in the upcoming update, our adorable pets are about to officially meeting their owners!

They are not just friends, but also handy assistants, a must-have for home defense and monster slaying!

[b]How to Capture Pets[/b]

Pets live in the wild or in caves across different worlds. To capture them, you need to use the right collar (e.g., regular Collar, Chant forest Collar). 

First, feed them the right food to fill their mood, then use the collar to capture them.

There are three types of collars, all of which can be crafted at the crafting table.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/5e699bad7bd4e3a7d675ec0604f15b6780f2824c.png[/img]

* new start players can pick one from these 3 beginner pets
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/37ddfaa1e7446669fe7bc762903601f4c04656ee.png[/img]

[h3]Types of Pets[/h3]

The types of pets include animals, beasts, monsters, and elemental creatures.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/653631609def0507a9aa67f2de8cd2bbedd0fb08.png[/img]


[h3]Mount Ability Name Change[/h3]

Movement- Trick
Physique- No change
Jump- Intellect
Endurance- No change
Load- Ferocious

New:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/0039eb870a6019ae1ef15f48f153a565c3089ee7.png[/img]

Old:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/1bd19117492d277298fe4c7f7eca907a25fe6d39.png[/img]


[h3]Breeding and Raising Pets[/h3]

Pets can also reproduce, and the breeding is the same as for mounts.
Younglings can be raised to adulthood using Nutrient once they reach full experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/abffd6b739d6d420f3ca59b2d1f62beeee203d2e.png[/img]


[b]Breeding Time Adjustment[/b]
The pet breeding time has been adjusted to 8 hours, and the breeding cooldown time has been removed.

[b]Pet Skill Training[/b]
To make pets reliable assistants in wild adventures, owners need to diligently train their combat skills, making them stronger through continuous learning.

[b]Combat Skill/Attribute Training[/b]
Combat skills and attributes are acquired by using pet scrolls.
When a pet uses a scroll, it will gain the corresponding skill or attribute.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/b05eaec13b9fbfad6f0706a65024a85096d10551.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/4a8c852f43aad82dcb8075ed41fe339a3e691c9b.png[/img]

[b]Ways to Obtain Scrolls:[/b] 
Scrolls can be obtained through dungeon loots, ocean  chests, and mob loots.

[b]Special Skill Training[/b]
Special skill training can be done at the "Hunter Hut - Barry." Each training session consumes a certain amount of Shadow Dragonites and allows you to regenerate your pet's special skills.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/a2d17c7ce2f2819219b4356bd03c8b239b05c061.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/2290fe2cb4ea6e48dad1261c1c198c5c4b539690.png[/img]

[h3]Pet Injuries and Healing[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/aed413447aa64af9959222f4b743807a70558cc1.png[/img]

When a pet's HP drops to 1 after being summoned, it will become injured.
After a pet is injured, it will lose 1 Mood Points.

To begin the healing process, place the injured pet in the Pet Storage. The healing time is 30 minutes.

Players can use a [u]"Pet Fast Heal Rune"[/u] to expedite the healing process or a "[u]Pet Instant Heal Rune[/u]" to immediately heal an injured pet.

[b]Pet Mood[/b]
Pet mood is divided into four levels:
0-20: Upset
21-80: Normal
81-100: Happy
100: Excited
If a pet's mood drops below 20, it will not enter combat mode.
Using a toy can increase a pet's mood by 10 points.
At Barry's, you can restore a specific pet's mood to 100 points.
If a pet's mood reaches 0, it cannot be summoned, displayed, or bred.

[h3]Toy merchant locations[/h3]

[b]Breeze Plain: Marina at the Dock[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/8bbc20829a81d861b26a39d05fb2cb7a7d8d1585.png[/img]

[b]Chant Forest: Which's Cottage- Idia[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/3611fc948a7825b8bd8dcf4ceafdae4e357921ef.png[/img]

[b]Blazing Desert: North Coast Valley- Rabia[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/841dc070a11ac0f4940f76d97f394051fddcb32b.png[/img]

[h3]Pet Storage[/h3]

When you can't carry all your pets with you, you can store the extra pets in the Pet Storage. 

The Pet Storage can be crafted using the crafting table.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/57b8b9e39e37cb5dab84784990cc783079f9dc0d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/692ce2e09642d7f26afb29e9f8b76b0f3dd59360.png[/img]

The Pet Storage comes with 30 slots by default, and you can expand it to 60 slots using 200 PinkStar.

[h3]Mount Burden:[/h3]
[b]The item Mount burden has been removed. [/b]
The carrying capacity (i.e., the number of items your pet can carry) is now determined by the pet’s own weight limit.
All burden crafting recipes have been removed.

[h3]Pet Dispatch[/h3]
Do you often feel burdened by grinding materials during your journey? 
Don’t worry, you can now send your pets out to gather materials using the Pet Dispatch Station.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/14ad425eda77eb5974af422ed880b18f37fb07b5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/9875c04effb37b2c474dc048bb4a09fc7ef26ec6.png[/img]

Pet Dispatching Rules:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/3d1aa00970948c0fe0e093a9fe36f2414cdd2785.png[/img]
*The Pet Dispatch Station can be crafted at the crafting station.


[h3]Paw Patrol to the Treasure Hunt![/h3]

We've welcomed two adorable new members to the team—[u]Border Collie and Golden Retriever![/u]

[b]How to Get Your Pet Dog:[/b]
[b]Method 1:[/b]
You can obtain them through quests. After update, during your main storyline, an ability quest to get pets will automatically trigger.

Completing[b] Mora's quest [/b]will reward you with a pet cage containing a Golden Retriever.
Completing[b] Ine Ma's quest [/b]will reward you with a pet cage containing a Border Collie.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/f74751afd13f50bc05bdccb8b078d099087bd77c.gif[/img]

[b]Method 2:[/b]
You can also purchase them directly from Mora's Pet Store in Breeze Plain.


[b]Special Skills of Pet Dogs:[/b]

[u]Diligent Worker[/u]: Can be assigned as a pet for any race when dispatched.

[u]Fierce Bite:[/u] This skill enhances the pet's attack abilities.

*More pets will be added in future updates.


[h3]Treasure Map System[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/5055b830e3099532b37cc74726c0c39f5d22697c.png[/img]

[b]How to Obtain:[/b]
Normal Treasure Maps: You can randomly obtain a treasure map as a reward for completing daily tasks.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/64ea2a85baf84fa677e3198b29b25cafd31d51ff.png[/img]

[b]Rare Treasure Maps: [/b]Can be crafted at the crafting table using all 5 treasure map fragments.
*Treasure map fragments drop randomly during regular digging.

[b]How to Use Treasure Maps:[/b]
Treasure maps can be used directly from your backpack or while holding the item.
●Use the treasure map in the corresponding world to open a mini-map that shows the general location of the treasure.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/7128a7d1502e445ca9a56f6fa426df778b7898ef.png[/img]

●When you’re close to the treasure spot, use the map on your dog. The dog will bark in the direction of the treasure chest.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/41d31a0c506408ac721b3f0f6d03ec849877c58e.gif[/img]

●When near the treasure spot, use the map again, and your dog will dig up the treasure chest.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/2337a274a26012c5642ff17e91ef58b651c45c6e.gif[/img]


[h2]Significant Adjustments to Mystery Realm Difficulty[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/e09fca78e82b701801e05a8f2e63278dc4686b6e.png[/img]

[b]Major changes to the normal and hard realms in all three worlds.[/b]
The original mechanisms and route settings have been removed, allowing adventures to enjoy dungeon runs more quickly! This greatly reduces the time needed to open chests.


[h2]Blazing Desert Whole map[/h2]

The long-awaited second half of the Blazing Desert map will open up after the update,
and the complete Blazing Desert map is available for all adventurers.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/cae19d841f12d67b5e5af321d350d1f5a00c7a50.png[/img]

Additionally, the level cap for Adventurers will be [b]increased to level 30[/b], providing everyone with more challenges and more room for growth.

[h3]Mystery Realm— Valley of the Kings.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/76d4eed95f6cb0e8596292fae45331f0cfe8c233.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/8fd6ad41e11143bc646b6928c9a0e7290639c569.png[/img]

In this mysterious land, you will face a powerful new boss: the Pharaoh.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/3d8dad79142033e8da6b44f83a83c83c32927cf4.png[/img]

[h3]Mystery Realm — Temple of the Sun[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/426c56deb5be3b200b9e69d090cb40459884463d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/6d6e451842f6955216cbdb50e01571a97d16f1ee.png[/img]

Located in a brand-new palace, it is the dream of Nefertiti.
Whether it’s a nightmare or a sweet dream, a conspiracy or an honest confrontation, it’s time for it to end.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/f2beeb62ef7c80ab76b50f37c458abe54da176b0.png[/img]
The Temple of the Sun will drop brand new advanced accessories, so adventurers, come and take on the challenge!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/1e78a50fba817ac6ac404d6ac4bff557b2824873.png[/img]
Please note that adventurers who reaches level 26 can be enter.


[h2]Defeat the World Elites![/h2]

[b]All 3 world now have world elites.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/16bcf717fc86e585aaee15c49a320a2511dd2b84.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/b235289dcccba47e40459c2f48831d84a83a30f0.png[/img]
Defeating them will grant Dragonitea and a large amount of experience

Defeating Blazing desert world elites will get a chance to get [b]T3 soulstones, and Lesser Temperite sands. [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/19d637b8c35172389ef41ca45d63ba2ccd63dda9.png[/img]
Soul Stones:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/513268bbad738e46508ea480daa5ecae6d53c13a.png[/img]

You can now view the location of world elite monsters on the map.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/9b3c13e21da61f800eecb21b1695f54e72c9e37f.png[/img]

Keep in mind that these world elites may change positions over time, so stay updated!

Note: You can open up to 5chests daily


[h2]Cooking Recipes and Life Skills[/h2]

Direct Purchase of Cooking Recipes:
New Recipe Stores has been added to the all three world, where you can purchase cooking recipes related to life skills for the corresponding world.

Recipe Shops Location:
Breeze Plain—Village (Mora)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/0814c874b312cb6f9233e4101685fdc6648dcb95.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/9215cf1cdd7287e345f7e548df82df974dc84f5c.png[/img]

Chant Forest—Tree house (Maple)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/0be4d2be0faca2b01e3e19dcb061527927180451.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/99bd8195af0314f89e09d0f2697eaa0d559cc1bd.png[/img]

Blazing Desert- North Coast Village (Restaurant Owner)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/620813fc3f503856914dfd90c1554402479334a7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/b96d4b09dd9fd4656756ae7abb889ef08545e264.png[/img]

[h2]Preview of Blazing desert weapon Looks[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/293a63e9646d8204f8dcfe1ec0d0441fa504832d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/dc455fad4bfbb61aeee36ea1e0a4f9c6211371d6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/813510437d23556525b8ff963703883e868ae265.png[/img]

[h2]Storage Space Upgrade[/h2]

[b]The Preserving Box storage capacity has been adjusted. [/b]
Originally 10 slots, with an additional 20 slots for Starshroud members, 
It is now changed to 20 initial slots, with an additional 40 slots for Starshroud  members, making a total of 60 slots.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/f792696ae1fec5d3db319ceecead1c90f50a6ffe.png[/img]

[b]Storage Box Capacity Adjustment[/b]
The storage box capacity has been expanded from 5 pages to 8 pages.
The cost to expand the storage box has also been adjusted accordingly:
Third page: 300 Pink Diamonds
Fourth page: 500 Pink Diamonds
Fifth page: 800 Pink Diamonds
Sixth page: 1000 Pink Diamonds
Seventh page: 1000 Pink Diamonds
Eighth page: 1000 Pink Diamonds
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/9e14945d1dcbe1d38f0062380888b8cdf1217cd7.png[/img]

[b]Costume Inventory Capacity Adjustment[/b]
The capacity has increased from 120 slots to 200 slots.


[h2]New Item: Finished Building Blueprint[/h2]
[b]Store in Workshop Cloud Archive:[/b]
Finished building blueprints can be stored in the workshop’s cloud archive. When generating a blueprint, the required building materials will be consumed.

Placing Blueprint Buildings: Once you’ve generated a finished building blueprint, placing the building will no longer consume additional building materials.

New Player Reward: New players who complete the main storyline quests can choose one finished building blueprint from the following available buildings as a reward.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/2695c716a369e374567d6d6fb2b842160ef0b51c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/10cd502ef0144e8a2530019c2332cc310df977ba.png[/img]

Usage Restrictions: Both empty finished building blueprints and finished building blueprints can only be used on your personal territory.


[h1]Important Notice: Server Merge Announcement[/h1]

Dear adventurers,

To enhance your gaming experience, we have decided to merge the European and North American servers [b]within next three weeks[/b].[u] (After the game update)[/u]

During this time, all player data from the EU server will be transferred to the NA server. Once the migration is complete, the EU server will no longer exist, and all former EU server players will be able to log into the NA server to continue playing.

Please note that during this data migration, we will make every effort to preserve the majority of your data. However, as Dragon and Home is a large-scale online sandbox MMPRPG with complex and varied data structures, some data may undergo changes after the migration is completed.

We appreciate your understanding and support. We will do our best to ensure a smooth server merge. If you encounter any issues during the migration process, please feel free to contact us.

We hope you continue to enjoy your adventures in the new server!



DnH Dev team

notes.title: UPCOMING UPDATE! Pet Pups!
notes.content:
[h1]No Challenge is Too Tough with Brave Pups! [/h1]

[h2]Paw Patrol to the Treasure Hunt![/h2]

We've welcomed two adorable new members to the team—Border Collie and Golden Retriever! 

Finally, we now have our puppies in the game!

[b]How to Get Your Pet Dog:[/b]

[b]Method 1:[/b]

You can obtain them through quests. After update, during your main storyline, an ability quest to get pets will automatically trigger.

Completing Mora's quest will reward you with a pet cage containing a Golden Retriever.

[b]Friendly and warm-hearted, this little Golden Retriever excels at searching![/b]

Completing Ine Ma's quest will reward you with a pet cage containing a Border Collie.

[b]Smart and agile, this little cutie is a top graduate from Doggy University![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/f74751afd13f50bc05bdccb8b078d099087bd77c.gif[/img]


[b]Method 2:[/b]
You can also purchase them directly fro[b]m Mora's Pet Store[/b] in Breeze Plain.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/bc8f09f7dab8d004fbe4435fe73e55b30afe2750.png[/img]



[b]Special Skills of Pet Dogs:[/b]

Diligent Worker: Can be assigned as a pet for any race when dispatched.

Fierce Bite: This skill enhances the pet's attack abilities.

With these pups joining the adventure, your journey just got a lot more fun. 

Plus, they can help you dig up treasures! The Paw Patrol truly saves the day!

*More pets will be added in future updates.



[h2]Treasure Map System[/h2]

[b]How to Obtain:[/b]

Normal Treasure Maps: You can randomly obtain a treasure map as a reward for completing daily tasks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/8ed16d3686bb8385ec4d2867002bbf1de7e4cc78.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/6c15b32a54ec324d69fa79aaa73c9be7f0951b0e.png[/img]

Rare Treasure Maps: Can be crafted at the crafting table using all 5 treasure map fragments.
*Treasure map fragments drop randomly during regular digging.


[b]How to Use Treasure Maps:[/b]

Treasure maps can be used directly from your backpack or while holding the item.

●Use the treasure map in the corresponding world to open a mini-map that shows the general location of the treasure.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/7c8618f45a54868c3918ad44131975c037fff8de.png[/img]

●When you’re close to the treasure spot, use the map on your dog. The dog will bark in the direction of the treasure chest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/41d31a0c506408ac721b3f0f6d03ec849877c58e.gif[/img]

●When near the treasure spot, use the map again, and your dog will dig up the treasure chest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/2337a274a26012c5642ff17e91ef58b651c45c6e.gif[/img]

[i]Some treasure chests may be guarded by monsters, so be careful![/i]


[h2]New World Elite Monsters in the Desert[/h2]

You can now view the location of world elite monsters on the map. 
Keep in mind that these world elites may change positions over time, so stay updated!

[i]Note: You can open up to 5 treasure chests daily [/i]


[h3]New Elite in the Blazing Desert—Giant Slime King[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/b235289dcccba47e40459c2f48831d84a83a30f0.png[/img]

Defeating world elite monsters in the Blazing Desert will reward you with experience and White Dragonites.

 Opening the treasure chests also gives you a chance to obtain Intermediate Lesser Temperite sands and  new Soul stones.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/d71e0264d2c94fbe23b9e4123b8d2527a37a631b.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/513268bbad738e46508ea480daa5ecae6d53c13a.png[/img]


[h3]Cooking Recipes and Life Skills[/h3]

Direct Purchase of Cooking Recipes:

New Recipe Shops has been added to the all three world, where you can purchase cooking recipes related to life skills for the corresponding world.

[b]Recipe Shops Location:[/b]

Breeze Plain—Village (Mora)
Chant Forest—Tree house (Maple)
Blazing Desert- North Coast Village (Restaurant Owner)


[h3]Pet Storage and Pet Backpack[/h3]

[b]Pet Storage:[/b]
You can now craft a Pet Storage at the crafting table and place it anywhere in your home.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/59b39bb1752c5c451763cd167f6d0b1d8e8f7d4e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/0a9a8591e049b6374cb2f42d38203e864c6c7d44.png[/img]

The Pet Storage comes with 30 slots by default, and you can expand it to 60 slots using 200 PinkStar.

[b]Mount Burden:[/b]
The item Mount burden has been removed. The carrying capacity (i.e., the number of items your pet can carry) is now determined by the pet’s own weight limit.
[u]All burden crafting recipes have been removed.[/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/36aa1cf4ccef1e9dd0421c343daaea0800bc9783.png[/img]


[h3]New Item: Finished Building Blueprint[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/4a4426236d045c36b4b23d1d87306ab750ced141.png[/img]

[b]How to Use Finished Building Blueprints:[/b]

[b]Store in Workshop Cloud Archive:[/b]
Finished building blueprints can be stored in the workshop’s cloud archive. When generating a blueprint, the required building materials will be consumed.

[b]Placing Blueprint Buildings:[/b]
Once you’ve generated a finished building blueprint, placing the building will no longer consume additional building materials.

[b]New Player Reward:[/b]
New players who complete the main storyline quests can choose one finished building blueprint from the following available buildings as a reward.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/2695c716a369e374567d6d6fb2b842160ef0b51c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/daba1ce854c2b48d605202dd2030ce367b398b1b.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/10cd502ef0144e8a2530019c2332cc310df977ba.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/d427655ad55a55ec2bdc58d8267b729d26b40756.png[/img][/url]

[b]Usage Restrictions:[/b]
Both empty finished building blueprints and finished building blueprints can only be used on your personal territory.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/7e87c3f72f1021e5b16bf184c310bf26e4327bee.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/e355f8bbf3cbee490761b22afd32f241984eb8ac.jpg[/img]

[b]Steps to Use:[/b]
1.Using an Empty Finished Building Blueprint:
a.Choose a building from your cloud archive or select an existing building blueprint.
b.On the left side, you will see the list of required materials for that building.

2.Preparing Materials:
a.Make sure the required materials are ready in your backpack and storage chest.

3.Generating a Finished Building Blueprint:
a.Click the "Ready" button. The required materials will automatically be deducted from your backpack and storage chest, and a finished building blueprint will be created.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/dc1c1cf80cef17d810fd227751deaf14d116645f.jpg[/img]


[h3]A Bouquet That Never Withers[/h3]

We’ve added two new handheld rose bouquets and a special flower-giving emote! 

[b]Handheld Rose Bouquets:[/b]
Two beautifully crafted rose bouquets have been added, adding a touch of romance to your character’s hand.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/1bdf6b15506310f6fb5400b5e43caa0548af7f0e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/9b80d89ea6ead404d38cd181edc228c1e85f0f25.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/4bb2369c3972fd2e670844a39549145e0aeb57da.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/8ba66e7a458a511fa403c0b47083e0b8fbaa0335.png[/img][/url]

[b]New Flower-Giving Emote:[/b]
A unique emote lets you vividly express your feelings by offering a bouquet to someone special, sending your best wishes in the most beautiful way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/66ab93bebd45ec77996f7f502241543b470f6318.png[/img]

These stunning rose bouquets can be purchased in the Starshroud shop. Pick your favorite bouquet and give your special someone a piece of everlasting romance!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/ddb7aa291c3bd4034e5e71f6bb5dec8649d2656a.gif[/img]


[h3]Other Adjustments and Fixes:[/h3]
The main storyline quests in the Chant Forest and Blazing Desert have been significantly reduced, offering a lighter load without reducing the rewards.

notes.title: Coming up! The Pet System!
notes.content:
[h2]Coming up! The Pet System![/h2]

In the perilous continent of adventure, do you often feel a bit lonely fighting alone?
To let our dear adventurous enjoy more fun in their journey, in the upcoming update, our adorable pets are about to officially meeting their owners!

They are not just friends, but also handy assistants, a must-have for home defense and monster slaying!

Each pet has its own special skills. Which one will you pick?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/bf1665d208d1cdf15f56ca0cf0eb19d376931afe.gif[/img]

[h3]How to Capture Pets[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/b56153ed4843c808905486c4aee796719e49bf06.png[/img]
Pets live in the wild or in caves across different worlds. To capture them, you need to use the right collar (e.g., regular Collar, Chant forest Collar，desert Collar). 
First, feed them the right food to fill their mood, then use the collar to capture them.

There are three types of collars, all of which can be crafted at the crafting table.

* new start players can pick one from these 3 beginner pets
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/37ddfaa1e7446669fe7bc762903601f4c04656ee.png[/img]


[h3]Types of Pets[/h3]

The types of pets include animals, beasts, monsters, and elemental creatures.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/653631609def0507a9aa67f2de8cd2bbedd0fb08.png[/img]


[h3]Breeding and Raising Pets[/h3]
Pets can also reproduce, and the breeding is the same as for mounts.

Younglings can be raised to adulthood using Nutrient once they reach full experience.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/abffd6b739d6d420f3ca59b2d1f62beeee203d2e.png[/img]

[b]Breeding Time Adjustment[/b]
The pet breeding time has been adjusted to 8 hours, and the breeding cool-down time has been removed.

[b]Pet Skill Training[/b]
To make pets reliable assistants in wild adventures, owners need to diligently train their combat skills, making them stronger through continuous learning.

[b]Combat Skill/Attribute Training[/b]
Combat skills and attributes are acquired by using pet scrolls.

When a pet uses a scroll, it will gain the corresponding skill or attribute.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/9e03e6409866625e9a0becda669eb6f705658298.png[/img]
Ways to Obtain Scrolls: Scrolls can be obtained through dungeon loots, ocean  chests, and mob loots.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/bf0bb0e09247e1314bfa47030bcb45435331a4ac.png[/img]


[h3]Pet Dispatch![/h3]

Do you often feel burdened by tedious chores during your journey? 
Don’t worry, you can now send your pets out to gather materials using the Pet Dispatch Station.

Seeds, ingredients, herbs…  you can dispatch the right pet to collect materials, making your adventure more enjoyable!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/14ad425eda77eb5974af422ed880b18f37fb07b5.png[/img]

[b][Dispatch World][/b] When travelers first arrive in a world, the corresponding dispatch tasks for that world will be unlocked.

[b][Dispatch Tasks] [/b]Only pets in the pet warehouse can be assigned for dispatch.
There is no limit to the number of dispatch tasks, but each dispatch task can only be carried out by one pet at a time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/9c8dc71ee742c95341f5f00d9823ecf861646d6a.png[/img]

[b][Dispatch Rewards][/b] The final reward for dispatching is accumulated from three aspects:

[b]The talent of the corresponding world’s dispatch task.[/b]
The dispatched pet’s current mood: Depressed state - 50% earnings, Happy or Excited state + 50% earnings.

The highest qualification level of the dispatched pet: S-level + 100% earnings, A-level + 60% earnings, B-level + 40% earnings, C-level + 20% earnings, D-level + 10% earnings.

[b][Dispatch Impact] [/b]The dispatched pet's mood value will decrease by 1 point, and the dispatched pet will consume hunger points during the task.

*The Pet Dispatch Station can be crafted at the craft table.


[h3]Significant Adjustments to Mystery Realm Difficulty![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/e09fca78e82b701801e05a8f2e63278dc4686b6e.png[/img]

Major changes to the normal and hard realms in all three worlds.

The original complex mechanisms and route settings have been removed, allowing adventures to enjoy dungeon runs more quickly! This greatly reduces the time needed to open chests.


[h3]Storage Space Upgrade![/h3]

[b]The Preserving Box storage capacity has been adjusted. [/b]

Originally 10 slots, with an additional 20 slots for Starshroud members, 
It is now changed to 20 initial slots, with an additional 40 slots for Starshroud  members, making a total of 60 slots.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/89518899a690b316c99ab862d486ed59b66a608a.png[/img]

[b]Storage Box Capacity Adjustment[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/eb85ad19fc279ee9f20b1b46193887c5ba234c91.png[/img]
The storage box capacity has been expanded from 5 pages to 8 pages.
The cost to expand the storage box has also been adjusted accordingly.


[b]Wardrobe Storage Capacity Adjustment[/b]

With more and more beautiful outfits, your wardrobe has no space?
Don't worry, the wardrobe has now been expanded as well!

The capacity has increased from 120 slots to 200 slots.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/2238f65e5a96ab64c50b18db2d2338a5d133a0a6.png[/img]

Please stay tuned for more update details!

notes.title: 【Dragon and Home】Coming Update Announcement
notes.content:
Dear players,

Thank you for your continuous support and love for Dragon and Home! 

We are excited to inform you that by[b] the end of August[/b], we will be releasing a major update for the oversea servers. This update will include all the content from the past major versions.


[h3]Void Isle：Explore the mysterious Void Isle with new quests, enemies, and treasures.[/h3]

Isolated beyond the four continents, floating in the void, these islands have lost the protection of the Tree of Life and have been corrupted by the magic born from the void, becoming a breeding ground for monsters.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/c1d560257819fa65007e0ba1db25ee38b2e69beb.png[/img]

However, high risk, high reward. These islands, far from the mainland, have nurtured numerous treasures from the immense magical power. More and more adventurers, tempted by the treasures, are willing to risk their lives to explore the void.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/37c09f1a83fc5f91ee213cd14abf4c318e74e740.png[/img]

To prevent unnecessary casualties among adventurers repairing the continent, the Lux Dracona has bestowed blessings at its ancient altar. Those who receive the blessing can temporarily shield themselves from the corrupting magic using the power of light. The Lux Dracona Altar has thus become a base for treasure-seeking adventurers. Every day, new adventurers delve into the void with hope. 

Adventurers at level 10 or above can talk to Iona in the village to receive the ability quest "Void Exploration."
After completing the ability quests "Void Exploration I" and "Void Exploration II," the Void Challenge will be unlocked.

[b]【Rules: Layers and Chambers】[/b]
The Void Isle is divided into Layers, each containing a varying number of Chambers. Each Chamber is a challenge.

Upon completing a challenge, players receive a rating: Bronze, Silver, or Gold. To progress to the next Layer, players must complete all Chambers in the current Layer with a rating of at least Silver.

[b]【Rules: Nearshore Isles and Far Isles】[/b]
The Void Isle consists of the Nearshore Isles and the Far Isles. After completing all Layers of the Nearshore Isles with a rating of at least Silver, the Far Isles will be unlocked.

The Nearshore Isles does not reset or change over time.

The Far Isles, influenced by the void, reset every two weeks and will have some changes.

[b]【Rules: Void Buffs】[/b]
Challengers are affected by the void, which can provide either buffs or debuffs. All challengers needs to be prepared.

Void Buffs may appear in each Chamber and throughout the entire Far Isles.

[b]【Rules: Rewards and Resets】[/b]
Conquering the Void Isle yields substantial rewards.
Each Layer has an overall rating that players can claim, which corresponds to the lowest rating among all Chambers in that Layer.
Every two weeks, on Monday, the rewards for the Far Isles reset and new Void Buffs may be introduced.
The rewards for the Nearshore Isles do not reset over time.

[b]【Rules: Challenge Rankings】[/b]
Upon completing the third Layer of the Far Isles with a Gold rating, players will be listed on the Void Isle leaderboard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/7a75e58e3ec6e8375eaeb96494701b4f784b65df.jpg[/img]



[h3][b]Photo System[/b]: Capture your favorite moments in the game with the newly introduced Photo System.[/h3]

In next update, you can take photos with your friends and beautiful scenery.
Supports manual focus and aperture adjustment. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/ae6cb19ee91e95edf5701854609bd790cc4458c0.png[/img]

There are also 32 filters to choose from, making your photos vibrant and fun instantly! There's definitely one that suits you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/3a755eb1ff7e057947263bc886be29de3f848c7e.png[/img]

We also optimized the lighting in the game and enhanced graphics visual effects.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/263ad98f1e0f670eb46f241efb31536dc366d2b1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/777e681cd7ed17b5812800095ec59457f23e4e47.png[/img]

Added character experience gain for crafting related life skills: blacksmith, tailoring, hunting, alchemy, carpentry, and cooking.

Adjusted the maximum number of residents in the co-home system (the maximum number of players in co-home is now 80)

There are more updates details coming up! Stay tuned!

Spruce Twigs can be obtained by completing event quests.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/a907d1a98ddb3df1f211295c0fd0f7b48331386b.png[/img]
(Some rare furniture can be obtained through Winter Star Realms or exchanged in the WinterStar Festival Shop.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/c76012cfa08289af52aeda81372a1c8067d15320.png[/img]


[h3]World Chest[/h3]
In every corner of the Breeze Plain and Chant Forest, there are randomly concealed chests of two different Level. Those who find the chest will receive generous rewards.

[b]Superior Chest:[/b]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/d880fe3d90db47692d400eae55c70c3e313c00fe.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/27f6b48b9f994b44f660e4a63badabc81ea859cb.jpg[/img][/url]

Simplify mechanics across all difficulty levels in Breeze Plain and Chant Forest Realms; reduce the number of mobs in Normal difficulty.

Life skills increase 1 point every 2 levels starting from level 10;
Basic level I for Blacksmith, Tailoring, Hunting, and Alchemy no longer requires life skill points for learning.

6.	Recipe Adjustments:
Adjust materials number needed for beginner equipment recipes; 
Add Breeze Plain Kite; adjust the number of materials needed for the Kite; add a recipe for 'Expired Food.'

7.	Auto-Equip Tool:
After update, mining, gathering, and tree chopping will automatically equip tools from the backpack if no tools are equipped.

8.	Addition of Private Events and Increased seed drop rate

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
Rectify the bug causing irregular jumping height during the double jump while riding mounts in specific states.

notes.title: 2.0.0 Version Update Announcement
notes.content:
[b]Update Date：[/b]
[b]NA Time[/b]: 29th November 9:00 PM(GMT-5)    6:00 PM(GMT-8)
[b]EU Time[/b]: 30th November 2:00 AM(UTC-0)     

[h2]New Continent - Blazing Desert[/h2]

On a fortuitous occasion, you and Sakura step on this fantastical new continent - the Blazing Desert

This vast world presents the splendor of ancient civilizations, offering you a unique experience of exotic charm.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/a5640eac8ef7879e1da7271661171f6eac3583a9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/4c60ac7b2e332357edf46ef73b646774dc906f53.png[/img]

In the home area, by using the [Portal: Blazing Desert], you can access the mysterious new world - the Blazing Desert.

[b]*To entry into the new map, all the main quests in the Chant Forest needs to be finished (you can craft the portal at the craft table)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/7dc4bd2b84f2504a7aca29eeb1c75109cbeb3aa7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/551536c4ec5990285df7263cbeb33b30906b3253.png[/img]

With the increasing difficulty of the exploration, the maximum level for character will be raised from level 20 to level 26.
[b]*Currently, only a part of the map in the Blazing Desert are open. In future updates, whole map will be unlocked, and the maximum level for character will be increased to level 30.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/347d9f6f7a789eaa1bad8b54e51df1979f9f6acb.png[/img]

[h2]New Story Line – The Illusional Deity[/h2]

A new continent, a new adventure, but... something feels odd. The faith in the Lux Dracona seems to be strangely absent here—different gods, beliefs in the sun... Is it merely a clash of beliefs or is there some sort of conspiracy behind it?

Joining with Sakura, let's unravel the truth behind the scenes and reveal it to the world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/bf20210434464b561875d3f0286410d297f69540.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/2716bc920869cfd80debbf8e92c1bb84d1acd8f8.png[/img]

[h2]The Abundant Resources in the Desert[/h2]

Within the boundless expanse of the desert, various rich resources lie hidden.
Now you have the opportunity to obtain diverse resources (such as crops, fish, minerals, and more) you can also capture unique desert mounts. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/9f699234869637a50726c7fe8f1a91c1d3fae81f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/6b831f70b4d4c097bf51e351f2120f23a0894ef4.png[/img]

Desert Fish Resources
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/473276c95da92c81fc02d365ab97cbf486e4004d.png[/img]

Capture the desert mount
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/e15010623cb73b0d77ff07e2ccfb2611ce3cb07c.png[/img]

New desert crops
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/f244a8747d214f1b5652089cf0a4cbac4e52fe3a.png[/img]

The harvest of crops will also bring the new dishes infused with new tastes
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/95706533b9591c1eb2fe9b5bea93555d9f0d07d9.png[/img]

[h2]New boat in the Desert[/h2]

Within the boundless expanse of the desert, besides mounts, the boats will serve as your frequently used transportation.
It's said that the Sunboats crafted in the desert are exceptionally well-made, capable of accommodating up to 5 people for a voyage together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/05fc65480f847867d1961d139717f211e69542f2.png[/img]

[h2]The Three Classes' New Gear[/h2]

By exploring the Blazing desert, you can obtain the materials for the three classes' new gear. Through crafting, you will acquire new gear sets with even stronger attributes.

[b]Warrior Set – Argentite[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/93d269409f765ee7d5409b1f0bdced0250ba692b.png[/img]

[b]Archer Set- Thick Leather[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/14e62501f6ad7525988f29ef12f794e8cfbe5c9c.png[/img]

[b]Mage Set- Flame yarn[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/2002df5b5116fcbdb961155c7aa4eb16eb4936d6.png[/img]

[h2]New Desert Mystery Realms[/h2]

[h3]New Mystery Realm – The Trial of Bastet[/h3]
The temple of the Guardian Goddess of Lower Kahyle has now fallen into disrepair. Despite its dilapidation, the ancient temple remains a shelter for many homeless people and stray animals to this day.

Bastet does not entirely obey the chief deity, as she remains staunch in protecting the Red Crown: 'To ascend as a king, one must first grace his people with benevolence.' If you wish to become the King of Kahyle, you must pass Bastet's trial.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/7d5361a90df23e0ba7e93485f0dd72c99aa84cd2.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/e6ca586133c9974b6f55c026333ea84b2b6ff4c4.png[/img]

[h3]New Mystery Realm – Temple of the Sky[/h3]

Nine primordial deities slumbered in the desert, once following the decree of the chief deity to crown the true kings of Thebes in ancient times.

The temple of Horus no longer serves as a symbol for the transfer of monarchy. However, as the ruler of the mythological era, Horus's eyes still watch over this land.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/5591da01378ac925db728cccf897def9c08423a4.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/1320a788061f80b75a4f72cc4f29bc78495fe85f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/6d76d2f00ddc996866bbf383e00e17e0c5525c1f.png[/img]

[h3]New Mystery Realm – Temple of the Afterlife[/h3]

A temple that honors the guardian of the underworld. Appears even more eerie because of the tale that it serves as the entrance of the underworld. No matter the status in life, the souls entering the underworld will be judged equally by Anubis.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/09635f001c492953b512c5c3471cf089fc2aee36.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/107ea1d5bf7759d3088256170bf4e761bac49b06.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/d223cf3409263c31e8b7e6c7791ad946de1b407a.png[/img]


[h2]Power Enhancement - Wheel of Destiny[/h2]

A tale says that dragons collect treasures used to adorn their palaces. Under the influence of the mighty power of the dragon race, these gemstones resonate, possessing mysterious abilities.

This power can awaken the ancient blood within humans, granting human race a brief taste of the power of dragons...


[h3]Mystical Treasure - Dragon's Legacy[/h3]

It's said that certain people in the Blazing desert can help you obtaining the Dragon's legacy

[h3]Wheel of Destiny[/h3]

To gain the enigmatic power of the Dragon's Legacy, it needs to be set into the Wheel of Destiny.

As you explore the desert, completing certain quests will grant you access to this sacred item.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/4f9f21cf8985f7a342a84a923c9b77ffec9ab30c.png[/img]

If you are not satisfy with the current power, you can further enhance your Dragon's Legacy by having it absorb more gemstones, amplifying its mysterious power.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/e0b88f0a5e34b3fabc0e73fa5eb38b24907a81e0.png[/img]

[h2]New World Event- Mystery Encounter[/h2]

Adventures in the desert not only entail encounters with various monsters but also provide opportunities for mystery encounter.

Upon triggering a Mystery Encounter, you will need to finish a special challenge, upon completion, will bring you surprises.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/9b4d9563572ac8aa2cdf85f2f373566e024b69a5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/231019253568330d49ccb89e92badf2a6c45f87e.png[/img]

[h2]Life Skills and Achievements[/h2]

With the introduction of resources from the Blazing desert, various life skills and achievements have also has new enhancements.
Awaiting all travelers to break through them one by one

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/c5472a8636f425d19cd77ce1fffa9d983ec2a2c3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/6da3613ced7783eee15cc0efa1ae2ba63239f600.png[/img]


[h2]Exotic Fashion - Pharaoh Costume[/h2]

The new Pharaoh costume will be available in the Starshroud Store 

Owning a Pharaoh costume in the Blazing Desert will make you the most eye-catching presence in the city.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/a48fe8ae68fbeaf22b9cf42811d7b3cf404eef20.png[/img]

[h3]Resetting Life Skill Talents[/h3]

After the version update, all Life skill talents will be reset.


[h3]Experience optimization[/h3]

Entering Hard Mystery Realms  no longer requires vigor; all vigor consumption now occurs exclusively at the final chest.

notes.title: Update 1.0.38 Version Announcement
notes.content:
Update Date: June 25, 2023

[h1]Let’s celebrate the Dragon Boat Festival[/h1]

Event Duration: From the day of the version update until 11:59 pm, July 09, 2023

[h3]1. Complete the main storyline quests and experience the atmosphere of the Dragon Boat Festival[/h3]

The Dragon Boat Festival has begun, but the event seems to have encountered some trouble.
Izan is helping Captain Weiwu- who is in charge of the Dragon Boat Festival, seeking assistance to carry out the festival. Look for him for more information!

Visit Izan at your home and receive the main storyline quest for the Dragon Boat Festival - "Commotion in the Ocean"  Completing the quest will reward you generously.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/0983f4f2c496669c61341639b142d1b190d51106.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/7f87fb120d7b8f69166275d3b231c9183afbc6d6.png[/img]

[h3]2. Repel the angered Aquanima - Clearing the Race Track[/h3]
In the lively atmosphere of the Dragon Boat Festival, the Aquanima that were once dormant at the bottom of the sea have been awakened.
The angered Aquanima poses a serious threat to the Dragon Boat racing activities, warriors are needed to escort and repel the Aquanima on the sea. Embark on a boat and head out to repel the Aquanima!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/5652987f3c125f618ad90aa41edf7b039903bbe9.png[/img]

During the Dragon Boat Festival, complete the daily quest "Clearing the Race Track" to defeat the enraged Aquanima. Upon defeating it, a chest will show up and contains generous rewards.

*After obtaining your boat and completing the festival series quests, you can find Captain Wewu to teleport you near the location of the angered Aquanima.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/ea5375d438dbcfdfde395c0707f04c93cd399139.png[/img]

Aquanima skills Description:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/a5b16b10ec6c6cf1c7479b5b4356688df2ebce7d.png[/img]

[b]Festival Accessory - sweet olive spice pack[/b]

The Aquanima's chest may contain an accessory called the Sweet olive spice pack
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/0c1e4714944267e7868a05c42c24e77136ae7ab2.png[/img]

[b]Special Potion - Orchid bath[/b]

Inside the Aquanima's chest, you can obtain a bundle of Fragrant Orchid
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/066479139d3e73b11a002c59226f66c1fc82396a.png[/img]
Orchid grass, when cooking orchid grass in a cooking pot, a medicine called Orchid bath can be made
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/d3c9c7cc1d6b8ffd783e6c719bdf88b184a19a54.png[/img]

Made from fragrant orchid, can be used in a bathtub to change its content. You will obtain special buffs by bathing in orchid bath water.

When you are immersed in the bath for 1 minute, it will gain the "Strong body" buff, which lasts for 1 hour.
*After the bath is complete, the medicinal bathwater will be deleted. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/cac4930b1f59d43e1b3f6b07ebcf47bbdcb14f58.png[/img]

[b]Special Item - Dragon Boat Drum[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/4660a19f9b674033ce439161f92416cd1b0b2da2.png[/img]
The Aquanima’s chest also contains a fun item called the Dragon Boat Drum. It can be placed in your own home, and once interacted with, you can enjoy the pleasure of drumming
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/1bdb6119c6ea42110654cff74a067e2c149f4746.png[/img]

[h3]3. Participate in Dragon Boat Racing and Compete! [/h3]

During the Dragon Boat Festival, a thrilling Dragon Boat race is held at the Fisherman's Wharf. As long as you have your own boat, you can sign up for the event by talking to Captain Wewu. After assisting Captain Weiwu in preparing the racecourse, you can take part in this exciting competition.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/9be606aa02aed96090800b120e2949e42b6c7564.png[/img]

During the Dragon Boat Festival, if you complete the daily quest "Dragon Boat Racing" for a total of 7 days, you can choose one Rice Wraps Decor and also a dragon boat drum as a reward to bring back home
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/5e6f7d60fbb7ba792debd7d0ab58a129cf6449c7.png[/img]

[b]4.	Cloud Crane Costume Returns[/b]
The elegant Cloud Crane costume is making a limited-time comeback in the Starshroud shop. Don't miss out!
*Female character can change thir hair color, but the male can not change hair color,remains black
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/19602ce90799c4b50861ea03d52c549e12270354.png[/img]

[b]5.Big change of Food Table[/b]
In order to facilitate teaming up for outdoor adventures, in this update, the food that was previously placed on home dining tables can now be brought anywhere (including revival points in the realm) and shared by setting up a picnic table. Everyone can enjoy the food together.
*When consuming food on the picnic table, an eating animation will automatically play.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/10c1e48414821bb910d07581922934357447adcb.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/6032b56be50b9f3bf1b60a39ce204759e2041792.png[/img]

[b]Home Visit Optimization[/b]

When you are within the range of your own home or post station, you can click on someone's character information to directly visit their home.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/f42599c8dbc0e60c735621aca9d4dd2d62292953.png[/img]

[b]New Hairstyles for Characters[/b]

Several new hairstyles have been introduced for both male and female characters. You can purchase them through the fitting mirror.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/da28d4e289c44ae37a741019143ee537d5f8ebfe.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/22f68c689e24d32b48f8b6d2f18fb8edf829ed9e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/bb4d50652a4f18587650516a1abbca1bf2cec895.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/19e7f4d97d24bcca532823a19510303e597f49d9.png[/img]


[h2]Fixes and optimizations:[/h2]

[b]Teleport Optimization[/b]: Using Resonates will no longer consume them. The cooldown time for VIP has been reduced.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/f1a30a54bf7836076b526e53f2be808206026e7d.png[/img]


[b]· Adjusted Fish Spawning Points:[/b] Reduced the swimming distance of fish to allow for more freedom in fishing.

[b]· Mystery Realm Optimization:[/b] Decreased the difficulty of certain levels.

· When deleting a character, a confirmation prompt with the input "delete" will appear to prevent accidental deletion.

· Changed some interfaces for mobile devices.

New scenery preview:

[h2]New Farm Crop - Rice[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/34e3beb6d6e136ab9a707f8b19ebc443749d511a.png[/img]
Slay Breeze Plain mobs to obtain rice seeds. They need to be planted on watered soil. (Welcome, to the rice field.)

Slay Chant Forest mobs to obtain Longjing Tea plant seeds. Grow them to obtain Longjing Tea Leaves.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/e686009af30a493317827fde1ee886408e54f9be.png[/img]


[h2]New Costume - Spring Set[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/5fd0fed1d7b4200d47a2aba614a12cf4a07f9579.png[/img]

Tamed Mount limit is the same as number of the Taming Stable slots. You will not be able to return the ones that are over the limit back to the Taming Stable.

notes.title: Update 1.0.34 Version Announcement(EU and NA)
notes.content:
Update Time：Feb. 22. 2023

[h1][b]1.	Tracking System[/b][/h1]
It can be a tiring task to keep track of all your quests and resources in a huge open-world sandbox experience.
We have developed a tracker system so that you may enjoy the game minus the annoyance of keeping track of everything.

[h2][b]a)	Quest Tracker[/b][/h2]
When you accept a side quest, a [Track Quest] option will be available.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/acc5ecb2850642b502267e83bbf406db7a4acb1e.png[/img]

After clicking on [Track Quest], a pointer will appear on your map which will lead you to the related areas so you may find your targets easily.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/97030b9679f52caf6fc1a9761a18e8fae774191e.png[/img]

When tracking a certain resource type, they will emit a glow that makes identification easier.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/27ba916f17db27cb09bb17ea756229fed768a52f.png[/img]

When tracking a particular NPC, it will show the distance between your character and this NPC. You can also see the location of the NPC on your map.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/944850d63da921568bd0d19368dac959d05ee6c9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/13455fc6f4676321cffbbf19a6d93bcbbb5baef2.png[/img]

[h2][b]b) User Defined Tracking[/b][/h2]
Other than tracking your quests, you may also fully utilize the tracking system to locate the content you wish to find during your exploration in the wild. Click on the [Locate] icon to your left after opening up your map interface to open up free tracking interface.

Put in the content that you wish to track, then the locations to find it will be marked on your map.

*When User Defined Tracking is in progress, the original quest tracking will be suspended. You can track your quest again by clicking on Track Quest again in the quest interface.

[b][h1]2. Daily Quest Adjustments[/h1][/b]
1 - Reduced content related to life skills from daily quests.
2 - Home Quests will now be given as a bundle.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/29db14f06c43a18bf865785863f050eaa9cc331a.png[/img]

notes.title: Dragon and Home Version 1.0.33 Update(EU Server)
notes.content:
Update Time：Jan. 16. 2023

[h1]The Year of The Rabbit is upon us! Enjoy the festival gathering[/h1]

Ready yourselves for the coming of the Year of The Rabbit.
Mountville Town at Breeze Plain is preparing for the annual festival gathering, bring your friends and have fun!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/c91fc7cdd48057078243b187f6d2e8ca1c2b37eb.png[/img]

[b]Lunar New Year Event: Day of Update to 24:00 12th of February, 2023.[/b]

[h2]Festival Minigames For Fun[/h2]
Partake in Lunar New Year minigames to obtain "Winner’s Red Packet”and festivity tickets.

[h3]Minigame 1: Lion Dancing[/h3]
[Game Rules]
Obtain Lion Dancing quest from the “Lion King”, get on your mount and reach the target platforms in order within the time limit.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/810bc0cb8eb91745affdc750418c2cdd15692706.png[/img]

[h3]Minigame 2: Jumping Dragon Gate[/h3]
[Game Rules]
Obtain the quest from Arley, and reach the target location within the time limit to complete the quest.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/5199966098a971f7a65f5d8cd1a35e4df6b5bf3c.png[/img]

[h3]Minigame 3: Archery[/h3]
[Game Rules]
Obtain the quest from Bukon, and hit the archery targets that appear at the tower in order within the time limit to complete the quest.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/1ab00eaeefae03f8d71efc59c5475013eff212f8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/9090aeec7bc101250c5bb483b0c8385f311a4f04.png[/img]

[h2]Festivity Gathering and Daily Quests[/h2]
Complete [Daily Quest - Festivity Gathering] for experience and white dragonite as rewards!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/ee6a3c0321b1c12d8e7da682aaa620bc9a637883.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/8822a48f9f27d9cf03bb09de0864d684ff2a5a27.png[/img]

[h2]Izan’s Lunar New Year Quest - Explore The Mysterious[/h2]
Speak to Izan to obtain and complete all the main quests for a handsome reward!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/18dbd55dcc2d2b79418f99fda0fb0a4a3bd1b75f.png[/img]

[h2]The Ritual of Welcoming Zao Jun[/h2]

Harvest crops or use Winner’s Red Packet and New Year’s Red Packet for a chance to obtain [Malt Sugar] during the event.
Hold malt sugar in your hand and use it towards the Zao Jun Statue to obtain festivity tickets. Limited once per day.
*Complete Event Main Quest [Welcoming The Gods] or use festivity tickets to obtain the Statue of Zao Jun.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/bc1b2c6d1b63f01e17a534009c439c5c4e9c26d7.png[/img]


[h2]Exchange Festivity Tickets For New Year Presents[/h2]
The stall owner is selling plenty of festival themed goods, you can exchange for them with festivity tickets.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/d5914a1b6b78f6150e1f181a0c89122a82a843fe.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/1e2094122043cd712b26d004fab0c1db5e41ff55.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/abcbdeddb38c825d84f449be8ff4973fa05be355.png[/img]

[h3]New Item 1: Lucky Tiger Mount Cage[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/cf4df6a8f3979213d1441b2688dcaa9a736784c1.png[/img]

Use to obtain the Lucky Tiger mount.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/8573ad4e0281510a6e7f286951636d75ce07deed.png[/img]

Young pets obtained from mating a lucky tiger that has a rank S property will have a 50% chance to trigger a special mutation, causing them to turn into a young Nian Beast.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/e08ab1df4d989b060653fdbc48add48afc93e4e9.png[/img]

[h3]New Decor 2: Dancing Lion Head[/h3]
Put these up for the festival vibe!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/8d61f7b605d89698ca8e3b8c92dd058b9b4f7564.png[/img]

[h3]New Item 3: Luna New Year Fishing Rod[/h3]
Event exclusive fishing rod, it may bring you good fortune.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/84e73ba3fad14f834b07423ba145920b9f471ba5.png[/img]

[h2]Make a Gift Package and Visit Your Friends[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/6722852b73aeb14ecb1d2ad14a2ee5c3cdd97a99.png[/img]

You can craft [New Year’s Gift Package] at the crafting table.
Hold a New Year’s Gift Package and use it on a player performing the Bow and Greet emote.
Both of you will obtain a New Year’s Red Packet, which grants random Lunar New Year items when opened.
[b]*First 3 uses of New Year’s Red Packet will reward you with festivity ticket.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/dbff52da6da398a12f4faa963195676424c655f3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/4788e854e24325eb10472154f43966108b49511b.png[/img]

[h2]Clean House For The New Year
[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/286c39a91eacd40624a18566424fc2db96f76106.png[/img]

New item Dusting Broom can be crafted from the crafting table.
Hold the dusting broom and use at the windows and doors in other player’s domain to obtain festivity tickets.
*You may dust other people’s windows and doors for a maximum of 5 times per day.


[h2]Fire Crackers To Scare Away Evil Beasts[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/2ea4fa15924940602ebe36160c20e4c546eb0610.png[/img

]
Evil Beasts will appear near the festivity gathering during the Lunar New Year event.
Fire crackers will make it a lot easier to defeat them!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/a06dbb609f1063f9edd339d59bb669076ecb01d9.png[/img]

Use a peach wood sword against the remains of a defeated evil beast for a handsome reward.
*The first 5 times you defeat the evil beast will reward you with festivity tickets.

Peach Wood Sword: 
Crafted from the crafting table.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/d54d0a9c2103375cae0b15481f81feafb26353f5.png[/img]

Evil-Dispelling Fire Crackers: 
Has a chance to drop from wild monsters, or from Winner’s Red Packet or New Year’s Red Packet.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/2f1f13f26b4fd74674191ba43389b4a54c2b51f9.png[/img]


[h2]Drink up! Toso Sake![/h2]

Obtained from wine barrels. Grants a random elemental damage type for 5 minutes.
*You can purchase the recipe for toso sake at the Lunar New Year Grocer.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/f3fbfbce3b1781db9b361a5a13ee5e23e25484be.png[/img]

The ingredient to make toso sake, [Medicinal Packet], can be obtained from harvesting in the wild or using Winner’s Red Packet or New Year’s Red Packet.

Can be used to make Toso Sake.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/681d7aee65e7e34313f838ff59f2376513f21a65.png[/img]



[h2]Defeat the Nian Beast[/h2]

The Nian beast comes out every year during Lunar New Year festival and terrorizes the population of Mountville Town.
Head to the Lunar New Year mystery realm and defeat the Nian Beast!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/606cbb53d57d0a1990f1fd2fc5ef01058d85f287.png[/img]

The entrance to the mystery realm is hidden in Ayau’s lodge at the festival gathering.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/40dfb5c03d86ff8d21e6ae7c69999b82776ca93d.png[/img]

You can enter the Easy mystery realm once per day for experience point, currency as well as regular equipment.
Hard mystery realm will consume a pass ticket. There’s a chance to obtain Luan Feather Long Bow and Luan Feather Quiver.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/07d8b25a30b3c5198dd342c42d00c832c383fdb1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/a56269181d64ba22e1568da37b97a700f2157017.png[/img]

Luan Feather Long Bow has a chance to trigger Firework Arrow Rain skill; while Luan Feather Quiver has a chance to trigger Firework Arrow skill.


[h2]Put Up Wish Lanterns And Make A Wish[/h2]
Event Time: 22nd January 2023 to 24:00 12th February 2023
Craft a Wish Lantern from the crafting table and use at any water surface.
*First 3 uses every day will reward you with festivity tickets.


[h1]New Outfits for the New Year[/h1]
Put on some fancy new outfits just for the occasion!

[h2]Lucky Rabbit Costume[/h2]
Can be purchased from the Starshroud Shop for a limited time only.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/87ae4c2fb21ec7a2d322d54172a3e32d54f5f776.png[/img]


Dancing Lion Headwear
You can purchase red and gold Dancing Lion Headwear from the Starshroud shop.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/6b29e2303fe44407416ed7434e10f4b78022a310.png[/img]

Continuously play the minigames at the festival gathering for 20 days will reward you with the black gold dancing lion headwear.

[h2]
New Dance Move - Water Sleeve
[/h2]
If you like this dance move, remember to complete the event main quest [Sweep Away The Old And Welcome The New], and talk to Ayau to exchange for [Dance Move - Water Sleeve] 


[h1]Home Adjustments[/h1]
1 - Unallocated private zones can be changed to public zones. Public zones can also be changed to unallocated private zones.
2 - Home owner can setup exterior scenery at the home announcement board.
*Setup will cost a certain amount of Shadow Dragonite.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/439d68621398787b690a0e892cd7da5f539b74e1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/4921be365bb01d6f63dd063c55751009654c7943.png[/img]

[h1]Mount Adjustments[/h1]
1 - Mount Trading available now through the use of mount cage.

[How to Obtain Mount Cage]
You can cage the mounts you have with you through Barry the Hunter in the Hunter’s Cabin.
Every attempt will charge you varied amounts of Shadow Dragonite according to quality of the mount and deduct an attempt from attempts available. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/11ebfe278035fea502322ea57de86c573ab5926b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/98f44fd821295fe279352a58e0d330200c8825f3.png[/img]

Hint:
Click on [Info] on the mount cage’s menu will show details on the mount inside.

2 - Fast mounting is available. Now you can summon your mount and enter mounting state with a shortcut.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/e8984aef53841f368104e853cfa23386d42c7a32.png[/img]

3 - Now you can talk to NPCs, mine, chop trees, and harvest resources when mounted.
4 - Mount Training Adjustment: You may choose to keep the original skills or override with new ones after you pay for your mount’s training.

[h1]Other Optimizations and Fixes[/h1]
[Optimizations]
1 - Configurable automated smooth ramp motions are available.
2 - 5 new emojis are added to the chat interface.

[Fixes]
1 - Fixed a bug causing long sword abilities to not cause bleeding.
2 - Fixed a bug where putting away fishing rod after hooking a fish causing the obtained fish to disappear.
3 - Fixed an issue of the game freezing interacting with the teleporter crystal after pressing F10.
4 - Fixed an issue causing equippable level of decorations to be wrong.
5 - Fixed a bug where people can feed wild mounts at long distances.

notes.title: Dragon and Home Update Announcement Ver. 1.0.32
notes.content:
Update Time：Dec. 12. 2022

Jingling! It is again December! 
Now begins the holiday season, something we’ve all been waiting a whole year for!

[h1][b]Winter Star Celebrations. Behold! The Holiday Season![/b][/h1]

The Winter Stars shine brightly again in the northern skies, signaling the start of the Winter Star Festival.
Dear Adventurer, please immerse yourselve in all the festivities in this event.

Time of Event: From Date of Update to Jan. 9th 2023

[h2][b]1). Izan’s Festival Quest[/b][/h2]
In order for the adventurers to fully immerse themselves into the holiday spirit,
Izan has prepared a lot of daily quests.


[h3][b]1.Enjoy Delicious Ginger Bread Together[/b][/h3]
Experience the quest “Festivities and Sharing”and obtain the Ginger Bread House.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/d48f2375718950212fe2e6924a19ca932dbbc867.png[/img]

Use the Ginger Bread House on a player in begging emote and both of you will obtain a piece of delicious ginger bread.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/2666e51e84d7d1c87c0aa377cd009b3f531523fe.png[/img]

There is a chance for a Winter Star Celebration Hat (With randomized colors) to spawn on the player’s head upon consuming the ginger bread.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/1bba77284c67e5ca564dec6d283fb8c2892ae16c.png[/img]

[h3][b]2. The Mysterious Courier From Winter Star Santa[/b][/h3]
Winter Star Santa had all the gifts prepared, and is in need of a courier for his quest.
That courier would be YOU, Adventurer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/e4e707a10f408ba179c78b53ffde6a51e9b8c293.png[/img]

Take a letter and click on the mail box on another player’s Home Domain. Upon completion, the Winter Star Santa will send a festival mail to these mail boxes.

*You may only use the letter on the same private domain once per day.

Upon completion of this quest, you can obtain the Winter Star Mystery Realm Pass.

*You may also exchange Winter Star Mystery Realm Pass at Izan’s Winter Star Festival Shop for limited quantities.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/dff6d20c95100da879dc87cc42d41dbea2cbc38c.png[/img]


[h3][b]3. Romantic Kiss Under The Mistletoe[/b][/h3]

Complete the festival quest, Live Long And Prosper, by doing an emote with a friend under the Hanging Mistletoe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/43affa5c3088262395731db9f799d03df546cc6b.png[/img]


[h2][b]2). Prepare The Winter Star Stockings[/b][/h2]

When you are busy running errands for Izan throughout the Winter Star Festival Season, 
you can obtain rewards such as Winter Star Stockings.
Remember to hang these up on your wall, they’ll turn into Filled Winter Star Stockings after the 24th of December.

*If you take down those stockings after the event is finished, you will get nothing from them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/43561c722ba4742786efbbd7e4451a3ea382baf0.png[/img]

You may obtain the following rewards from the Winter Star Stockings:
Pinkstars / Mistletoe Sprig / Advanced Vigor Potion / Iron Ore / Cotton / Furhide


[h2][b]3). Snow Monsters To Keep You Busy During The Festival[/b][/h2]

The infamous Krampus is usually sealed away by the sun. Now during this time of the year when the sun is the weakest, he breaks out of the seal and is now poised for some despicable deeds.

Stand together, Adventurers! Defeat Krampus along with his evil kin and save the Winter Star Festival!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/073f03cd9434048a6985c6c5e96f34a6ca38bc45.png[/img]

The normal Mystery Realm that Krampus Younglings dwell can be entered from the Winter Star Tree located in the village at Breeze Plain.

You may enter this dungeon once per day to defeat Krampus Youngling and obtain experience, currency, as well as regular equipment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/1cde9f699a22289fcdb149ba463a89ee2f7f24f7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/3e1f238515486edb3d86f8903ecca1e6c83b6d26.png[/img]

The Hard Mystery Realm where Krampus dwells is located at the Winter Star Tree in the Snow Village inside Chant Forest. Only parties of 1-5 players may enter at a time.
Entrance to this Hard Mystery Realm will cost you 1 Mystery Realm Pass.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/b904bec1abc3946aa8beb0f3a7a15f0ce4a004eb.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/0d0a39756add4c465635de3d0f97136a8756cf68.png[/img]

Clearing this hard dungeon grants a chance of obtaining blue or purple quality gear such as the Winter Star Wand as well as the Winter Star Tome.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/57ba06a8a31a6ec845ab5e43465d62771c11ff8e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/77ee2228f81ab0c659e62250e30438bf286683c0.png[/img]

[h2][b]4). Set Up Your Winter Star Home![/b][/h2]

You can craft all types of home furnishing items from collected event material, the Mistletoe Sprig (Acquired through completing Winter Star Mystery Realms).
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/fff68218a0739302c2a428dabe56066a728c9414.png[/img]


In order to craft the furnishings, you need to first unlock Basic Carpenter II. The recipes can be exchanged at Izan’s Winter Star Store using event currency, Fir Twigs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/b1ddb6edb00640a92b747bcd77ecdf53edeb409a.png[/img]
 
To obtain Fir Twigs: Complete Event Quests.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/a907d1a98ddb3df1f211295c0fd0f7b48331386b.png[/img]

(Certain rare furnishing items can be found in rewards from Winter Star Mystery Realms or Winter Star Store exchange.)

List of All Winter Star Themed Furnishing Items:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/4bb9ee5c0c2617f0766b361ea3a4b69cd9bb5d75.png[/img]

[h2][b]5). Festival Special Sail Boat[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/081f5b65f768e01c961e672a3f0abe6e01f2f1af.png[/img]

We have also added 3 variants of Winter Star Festival themed sail boats, they can be crafted in the related crafting bench.
