notes.title: Dragon and Home 1.0.31 Version Updates(EU Server)
notes.content:
Time of Update：Nov 9, 2022

[h1][b]/ New Gamplay - Sail Boat / [/b][/h1]

Everytime when you see the endless sea, don’t you wanna get to the other side of it and explore?
With this new version, you may begin exploring the deepest ends of the sea!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/c0f66ab092bf7bebf50b73f50f86feeb2dfeb410.png[/img]

[h2][b]1、How to Acquire a Sail Boat[/b][/h2]
①There is a new side quest [Man of Mystery] available at Breeze Plain. (You may obtain this quest from Captain Jack at the Fisherman’s Docks after completing main quest [Sakura’s Investigation Results])

Upon completion, you will unlock the achievement [Out to Sea!], and the crafting of simple sail boat.

②You can craft simple sail boat with certain materials at the crafting table.

[h2][b]2、How to Sail[/b][/h2]

You may place the sail boat onto any water surface at Breeze Plain or Chant Forest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/cf83a40270bdcd5b934e297af32257954677784f.png[/img]

Click [Embark], and prompts on sail boat control will appear to the rightside of your interface.

[h2][b]
3、Adjusting the Speed of Your Sail Boat[/b][/h2]

When you raise your sails, your boat will be affected by the wind. (The wind changes direction and strength according to time and weather)
A captain needs to adjust the angle of your sail to change the direction and speed of travel.
When your sail is at an optimal angle against teh wind, you may achieve the maximum sailing speed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/58885247f084f36ba568315f7864e50b611acc60.gif[/img]

You may observe the flag atop your mast to learn of wind direction and adjust accordingly.
We wish you a full wind in the sails! Bon Voyage!


[h2][b]4、Ships’s Capacity[/b][/h2]

Simple sails boat may only have a max of 3 passengers at a time.
*You risk of sinking by going above capacity.


[h2][b]5、Durability Loss[/b][/h2]
Sailing and collision will damage the sail boat’s durability. You cannot repair the boat after it has lost all of its durability. At that point, you just have to make a new one.


[h1][b]
/ Marine Life Adjustments and Updates / [/b][/h1]
[h2][b]
1、Underwater Chests[/b][/h2]

Underwater chests will spawn at deep sea areas of Breeze Plain and Chant Forest. You may just find one if you’re lucky.
Opening them grants you rough gemstone of related worlds and ocean coins.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/743fd99811937d428ffe15d585583335830729e7.png[/img]

[h2][b]2、New Item - Rough Gemstone
[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/1e1fcb1a8b8d2ebcbb449a8a327d4283630e07ed.png[/img]

There are two types of rough gemstones, breeze plain and chant forest rough gemstones. They are obtained through opening related world’s underwater chests and using certain deep sea fish.

You may craft soulstones which can be socketed on necklaces, rings, and acceosries from refining rough gemstones at the alchemy table.


You may refine these soulstones. Every type of soulstones have three levels: green, blue, and purple.
*Soulstones of the same name only change in stats, not their effects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/ce733fd1f8b6eed8d16cc74ce38c00a42e594ab2.png[/img]


[h2][b]3、New Currency - Ocean Coins[/b][/h2]

Ocean coin is a new type of currency. You may exchange different themed furniture with ocean coins from Captain Jack at Fisherman’s Docks in Breeze Plain.


[h2][b]4、Adjusted marine life distribution and borders of the two main worlds. [/b][/h2]
You may not sail to the edge of the map with your naval vessel.


[h1][b]/ Updated Energy System /[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]1、New Energy System for short swords, archery, and mage weapons.[/b][/h2]

In combat, energy reduction rate is slowed.

Using certain abilities will cost energy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/3867666c37645284b73495276b56fdc5bac8d923.png[/img]

Hitting enemies with certain abilities will grant you energy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/9e3481fcbb98de8488963e07702296cc83b944fc.png[/img]

[h2][b]2、Adjustments to Abilities of All Major Professions[/b][/h2]

[Warrior]
· Canceled cooldown on shield bash and blocking, they now cost energy.
· Great sword no longer level up automatically with a full energy gauge. You now need to level up through certain abilities. Energy slash · Finisher and Spirit Slash can level up your energy gauge after hitting a target.

[Archer]
Arrowrain charge time reduced, and cooldown increased by 10s.
Retreating shot cooldown canceled, now it costs energy.

[Wizard]
Canceled cooldown for Flame Wreath, Ice Tempest, Hurricane, and Divine Wrath, they now cost energy to use.
Canceled cooldown of Enhanced Attack, Healing, Shield, Enhanced Armor, Enhanced Element, and Enhanced Resistance. They now cost energy to use.


[h1][b]/ Fixes and Adjustments / [/b][/h1]

· Early main quests had their difficulty slightly lowered.
· Fixed a bug related to player character movement distance under certain conditions.
· Adjustment to elite monster spawns due to changes in Chant Forest map.

notes.title: Plans of 2022 for DragonAndHome
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/84a8d84eb0dffc231ef95a1e791c287099406f2f.png[/img]

Dear players,
 The year 2022 has already begun, and I wish you all a happy New Year!
 I'd like to share with you our key plans and current progress for 2022, and hope you'll continue to follow and support us.

1. Multi-platform support
We are working on a mobile version (IOS/Android) and currently we have a working Demo version internally.
We are also working on optimizing the UI and interaction design for mobile platforms, as well as the performance of the application, which we hope will run smoothly on most mobile phones.

2. Support for multiple languages
 We are currently working on the translation of Spanish, German and other languages, and we are very grateful to the enthusiastic players who have volunteered to participate in this work.

3. Key plans of game content for 2022
First of all, we are planning a major revamp and update of the underground of the current two worlds (Breeze Plain and Chant Forest), which I hope will give players a fun underground exploration experience.
We are also doing outfits for life class roles, such as chef outfit for those who like to be a chef in the game.
We will also start the development of the third brand new world of adventure according to our development progress and the progress of the annual plan.

4. Improvement plan for current bugs and functional defects in the game
We will continue to do 2-3 updates per month in 2022.

Thank you for your support and attention!

Teddy
HIG

notes.title: 《龙与家园》1.0.4版本更新公告 （ASIA-CN地区）
notes.content:
版本更新时间：9月14日

[h2][b]主线任务丰富[/b][/h2]

为了萌新们前期更好的发展，主线任务将进行丰富与优化。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/efbeedf37621ae9da9bf499c0ff0505654afbbc8.png[/img]

[h2][b]新增水晶互传功能[/b][/h2]

本次更新后，龙宝们可在同世界的已激活水晶之间进行任意互传。
*水晶互传时需要消耗一定的白龙晶

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/ed71047c44fa5e68e470ba93cc31e0ec067002cc.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/fdd464363b26eb49af998841764abf83e6782640.png[/img]

[b]水晶激活条件：[/b]
需要玩家先前往该水晶所在位置点击激活，方可激活。


[h2][b]共鸣石玩法调整[/b][/h2]

本次更新后，玩家不需要通过共鸣石，即可在相应水晶处设置该世界传送点
*当异世界传送、死亡后复活，都将返回此传送点

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/5c2f061b86cf6123c5b626f64e1383a357adf188.png[/img]

使用共鸣石后，将直接返回该世界已设置的传送点
*共鸣石使用CD为30分钟，完成主线任务-前往家园后即可使用

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/a349cf1648a08044d42cd3b4051ab70d3bf835ac.png[/img]

共鸣石改为通过背包-制作界面即可合成

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/c84baf22a9e72aa9209ced767fda18406510c1b4.png[/img]

[h2][b]新秘境-丛林神庙[/b][/h2]

通过咏叹森林地图指示，抵达丛林神庙秘境所在位置。
秘境建议16级以上角色1-5人挑战，请于挑战开启前完成组队。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/b3801b253744f8f4f91af5195a7df277177a5dbe.png[/img]

*秘境奖励默认为队长分配，若队长无参与战斗或离线则自动变为各自拾取。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/08ee327374d5168f3962ed1d2bdda7cbddec5f61.png[/img]


[h2][b]咏叹森林迎来三大精英怪[/b][/h2]

咏叹森林将迎来冰原魔狼、羊魔卫队长、暗蚀巫师三位精英怪，击杀后将概率获得首饰、相应魂石。
精英怪们将会随机出现在咏叹森林的各个祭坛点上 , 当祭坛完全点亮时精英怪将诞生。
*精英怪较为强大，各位勇士可不要单人前往噢

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/7a383e7bde772775e67c17528cb31ae5bfa4400d.png[/img]


冰原魔狼:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/dec9c7e61b29f8417e5cf9aafe33267d5ec25e1f.png[/img]

羊魔卫队长：

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/e83ad2c988c894ebf9cf09048f69f900c1c2bccb.png[/img]

暗蚀巫师：

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/103db9bebb899a7028cf582c7dc3d9a20d1aae38.png[/img]

三大精英怪部分首饰掉落预览：

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40890470/a3d0e45d47379aded1e29271eab2d7af652ec416.png[/img]

[h2][b]魂石优化[/b][/h2]

1、野猪、木灵魂石镶嵌部位改为胸甲
2、降低魂石镶嵌的白龙晶消耗
3、新增3个精英怪相应魂石

[h2][b]其他修复与优化[/b][/h2]

1、烹饪配方优化
2、降低微风平原新手区域怪物强度
3、修复部分坐骑驮包无法使用问题
4、修复“使用炼金台”任务过程中，炼出坐骑培养液时不能完成任务的问题
5、更新后，烤炉需要解锁生活技能【厨师I】才能在制作台制作
6、修复部分道具家具名与任务描述不一致的问题
7、猎人小屋附近固定刷新草药以便进行相关任务玩家采集
8、上调捕捉坐骑的初始能力，使得坐骑后代繁殖更容易升级
9、对话NPC添加头顶名称显示
10、提升咏叹森林动物剥皮的食材产出
11、两大世界普通鱼低概率产出两种鱼油，稀有鱼必定产出对应等级鱼油
12、添加击杀咏叹精英怪相关成就
13、击杀秘境内NPC新增经验奖励，部分NPC新增货币产出

notes.title: Details about the official release plan
notes.content:
Dear Players,
We have officially launched the Chinese version on August 20, 2021, and this version is only available in mainland China.

Due to some issues with the Steam page, players in other regions may have received the launch notification as well, but found that the download button on the page was invalid. This is a normal situation and we are working with Steam to deal with it. I am very sorry for any inconvenience caused to players outside mainland China.

We're working on an English version for global players, and if all goes well, we'll start beta testing around October.
Thanks to all the MMORPG-loving and Sandbox-loving players for their attention.

HIG Development team
2021.8.20
